images.title: Where is the giraffe?
images.purpose: Show how a position is read: from 0 move east 8 steps to column 8, then north 9 steps to row 9, where the giraffe stands, and write (8,9) with the column first.
images.composition: A large grid of 12 by 12 squares with numbered lines on the left, a teal arrow east along the bottom and a green arrow north up column 8 to the giraffe; on the right, the three steps in words and the pair (8,9) with column and row named.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. At the top right of the grid, centred at x 1040 and y 60, the title Where is the giraffe? in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px). THE GRID: one grid of 12 columns by 12 rows of equal squares, every square 52 by 52 px, so the grid is 624 px wide and 624 px tall and holds exactly 144 squares; it covers x 130 to 754 and y 100 to 724, with thin grey #6B7280 grid lines (2 px), a 3 px dark #2B2B2B outline, and the bottom left corner at x 130, y 724. NUMBERS: along the bottom, under the grid, the 13 numbers 0 to 12 in teal #0072B2 bold 28 px, centred at y 752, one under each vertical line, number k at x 130 plus 52 times k (0 at x 130, 8 at x 546, 9 at x 598, 12 at x 754); up the left side, left of the grid, the 12 numbers 1 to 12 in reddish purple #CC79A7 bold 28 px, right aligned to end at x 116, one beside each horizontal line, number k at y 724 minus 52 times k (1 at y 672, 8 at y 308, 9 at y 256, 12 at y 100). There is no 0 on the left side. THE GIRAFFE: one amber #E69F00 circle 30 px across with a 3 px dark outline, centred at the meeting point of column 8 and row 9, x 546, y 256; the word giraffe, dark bold 28 px, left aligned from x 572 at y 240, to its right. No other animal or picture is on the grid. THE WALK: a teal #0072B2 arrow (8 px line, 26 px arrowhead) along the bottom line of the grid from x 130 to x 546 at y 724, 8 squares long, pointing east; then a green #009E73 arrow (8 px line, 26 px arrowhead) up the vertical line at x 546 from y 724 to y 271, 9 squares long, pointing north and ending at the edge of the giraffe circle. TWO PILLS, each a white rounded rectangle 190 by 40 px with a 3 px outline and bold dark 26 px text: 8 steps east with a teal outline, centred at x 338, y 696 (just above the bottom line); 9 steps north with a green outline, centred at x 436, y 490 (left of the green arrow). TWO RINGS: a teal #0072B2 ring (4 px, 40 px across) around the bottom number 8 at x 546, y 752, and a green #009E73 ring (4 px, 40 px across) around the left number 9 at x 104, y 256. COMPASS: a compass card, a square 110 by 110 px at x 1300 to 1410 and y 30 to 140, white with a #2B2B2B outline (3 px), with N at the top (centred at x 1355, y 54), S at the bottom (x 1355, y 116), W at the left (x 1324, y 85) and E at the right in red #D55E00 (x 1386, y 85), all bold 24 px, at the top right. RIGHT PANEL, x 840 to 1400: two boxes. Box 1: a white rounded rectangle at x 840 to 1400 and y 190 to 470 with a 3 px dark #2B2B2B outline holding three lines of dark 34 px text, left aligned from x 880 at y 250, 330 and 410: the first line Start at 0. the second line East: 8 steps to column 8. and the third line North: 9 steps to row 9. each line has a coloured dot 22 px across at x 856 (dark #1F2937 for the first line, teal #0072B2 for the second, green #009E73 for the third). Box 2: a white rounded rectangle at x 840 to 1400 and y 520 to 760 with a 4 px amber #E69F00 outline holding the pair (8,9) in a dark bold monospace font of 96 px, centred at x 1120 and y 610, set so that the 8 is centred at x 1062 and the 9 at x 1178; under the 8 the word column in teal bold 30 px centred at x 1062, y 690, and under the 9 the word row in green bold 30 px centred at x 1178, y 690, each with a short arrow (30 px) pointing up at its number. In all: 1 grid of 144 squares, 25 numbers, 1 giraffe, 2 arrows, 2 pills, 2 rings, 2 boxes, 1 compass card. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: Start at 0, move east to the column, then north to the row, and write the pair with the column first: the giraffe is at (8,9).
images.description: A 12 by 12 grid with numbered lines, a teal arrow 8 steps east along the bottom, a green arrow 9 steps north up to the giraffe, and the position (8,9) with column and row named.
images.context: Concept image for Reading a Position: Column and Row. It follows the idea of the zoo grid in your maths book (numbers on the lines, a walk from 0 east and then north) and uses this concept's own giraffe, not the animals asked in the book's questions.
images.teaching_notes: Walk the arrows with a finger while counting the numbered lines aloud, east first and then north. The slip to watch: starting with the north walk, or reading the numbers as the squares between the lines.

image_decisions.why: The numbered lines and the two-part walk make column and row countable and show that east comes first, which words alone do not.
